title: cicerbita sonchoides
intro: Cicerbita sonchoides, commonly known as False Dandelion or Sonchus-like Cicerbita, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions, such as eczema and dermatitis. The therapeutic actions of Cicerbita sonchoides are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
